author.name: Automation Alex
author.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.

challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: The supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, so we cannot risk the live forecast while testing the new model. I am willing to accept full governance on the CI/CD pipeline, which currently has no review step at all. That means formal sign off for every change to the deployment tooling. In exchange, the shadow environment must remain manual. I will not automate the shadow run because the current pipeline stability is fragile. If we force automation there, we risk breaking the nightly forecast job. I am trading the lack of oversight in our build tools for the safety of keeping the verification process under human control. This protects the live system while we verify the new model against the locked contract.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to accept full governance on the CI/CD pipeline in exchange for keeping the shadow environment manual, framing it as trading lack of oversight in build tools for the safety of human-controlled verification.
